svg.title: JOSIE — flowing wind
svg.desc: The cream dotted tree on a transparent background, with extra fine branches and 168 glowing round-dot leaves matching the supplied reference. Growth takes eight seconds and holds. The woody trunk and roots stay fixed. Branches and the thin upper leader sway softly, while the leaves retain their independent flutter. Nineteen varied stars fade in and out only in the sky above the ground.
svg.metadata: Original logo traced into SVG ellipses, extended with dotted twigs. Leaves are glowing round dots inspired by 1_1_josiefied_orange.png. Fully vector elements with a transparent background; no raster image embedded. Branch bending reduced by approximately 68 percent, with original leaf flutter timings and angles preserved. Stars remain above the ground. No video, external assets, or JavaScript.
